relationships.subject: Tetrahydropalmatine
relationships.evidence_quote: THP administration reduced the inflammatory response, oxidative stress, and apoptosis in addition to inhibiting autophagy via the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.

key_findings: THP improved random skin flap survival, angiogenesis and blood perfusion in rats.
THP reduced inflammation, oxidative stress and apoptosis and inhibited autophagy via PI3K/AKT/mTOR; rapamycin partially reversed this.
